planets.name: Kepler-398 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-398 with a 6.83-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-398 d was found in 2016 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-398. Its orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
